item.title: Partial Shutdown Underway as Immigration Standoff Freezes Parts of Government
item.description: (AURN News) — Parts of the federal government are shut down as Congress remains deadlocked over immigration enforcement following the deadly shooting of two U.S. citizens by federal agents in Minneapolis. The shutdown began Saturday but is far more limited than last year’s 43-day closure. item.title: Rosa Parks Remembered on Her Birthday
item.description: (AURN NEWS) – On this day, February 4, 1913, civil rights icon Rosa Parks was born in Tuskegee, Alabama.
